bias.zh: 下跌趋势 · 守住 $750，受制于 $806

read.en: Sandisk fell 2.7% on Nov 19 to $755.16, its lowest close since Apr 7 (the saved bar has no intraday range). It is below the 5-day ($804.6), 10-day ($852.0), 30-day ($1,142.5) and 100-day ($1,445.7), all falling, and the rising 200-day ($1,285.5). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 2, below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 30 ($1,005.34), and RSI is 29.4, oversold.
read.zh: 闪迪 11月19日下跌 2.7%，收于 $755.16，为 4月7日以来最低收盘（保存的 K 线无盘中区间）。股价位于 5 日（$804.6）、10 日（$852.0）、30 日（$1,142.5）和 100 日均线（$1,445.7）下方，四者均在下行，并低于上行的 200 日均线（$1,285.5）。MACD 自 10月2日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月30日起看空（$1,005.34），RSI 为 29.4，处于超卖区。

read.en: No level changed: the close held above the $749.4–753.9 support (Nov 17 and 18 lows, $750). Resistance is $776.2 (Nov 18 close), then $799–806.4 (Nov 16 low, 5-day, Nov 5 low and close) and $813.2–835.1. Support is $749.4–753.9, then $700. A close above $806.4 would target $813–835; below $749.4, $700.
